name: Training Assistance for Competitive Examinations
benefit: **Financial Assistance:** ₹20,000/- per student or the actual fee payable, whichever is less.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must belong to the non-reserved category. 1. The applicant must have secured 60% or more marks in the 12th standard. 1. The applicant must be undergoing training in a recognized/selected coaching institution for recruitment examinations conducted in UPSC, GPSC Class-1, Class-2 and Class-3, Subordinate Services Selection Board, Panchayat Services Selection Board and Government of India Railways, Banks etc. 1. The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed ₹4,50,000/-.
